# Hidden failure group detection: evaluation results

*Generated by `scripts/evaluate_hidden_groups.py`; do not edit by hand.*

* Seeds: data seeds start at 20000 (not used during development); detector seed = repeat index.
* 20 repeats per cell; training set 5000 rows; evaluation sizes [1000, 2000, 5000, 10000].
* Detector settings: `{"methods": ["tree", "kmeans"], "folds": 2, "tree_depth": 3, "tree_min_leaf_fraction": 0.03, "kmeans_clusters": 8, "kmeans_weighting": "residual", "min_group_rows": 30, "min_group_fraction": 0.02, "alpha": 0.05, "min_effect": 0.1, "min_rows": 1000, "min_errors": 50, "recalibrate": true, "recalibration_trigger_ece": 0.03, "max_ece": 0.15, "max_overall_gap": 0.15, "max_categories": 20, "exclude_features": [], "extra_columns": [], "report_groups": 10}`
* Libraries: python 3.12.1, scikit-learn 1.9.1, numpy 2.5.4, pandas 3.0.6.
* Run on 2026-10-16; 5200 detections in 75 s.

**Synthetic data only.** These tables describe behaviour on the patterns above; they do not show that the method works in general. With 20 repeats a rate of 0/20 has a 95% upper bound of about 16%, and 20/20 a lower bound of about 84%.

## Detection power

Number of runs (of 20) in which confirmed groups covered at least 50% of the planted rows. Each cell lists **tree / k-means / both**. A held-out pattern (marked †) was added after the detector's design choices were made.

| Scenario | n=1000 | n=2000 | n=5000 | n=10000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| two_feature | 11 / 0 / 10 | 16 / 2 / 16 | 20 / 4 / 20 | 20 / 5 / 20 |
| single_threshold | 18 / 0 / 17 | 18 / 0 / 18 | 20 / 0 / 20 | 20 / 0 / 20 |
| categorical_pair | 4 / 8 / 9 | 13 / 13 / 19 | 19 / 10 / 19 | 20 / 11 / 20 |
| oblique (not axis-aligned) | 1 / 0 / 1 | 7 / 0 / 5 | 18 / 0 / 18 | 20 / 0 / 20 |
| small_group (~2%) | 0 / 0 / 0 | 3 / 0 / 3 | 7 / 0 / 7 | 9 / 0 / 9 |
| three_way_categorical (~3%) † | 0 / 1 / 1 | 1 / 7 / 7 | 9 / 8 / 12 | 14 / 5 / 16 |
| young_low_income (~7%) † | 3 / 0 / 2 | 8 / 0 / 8 | 19 / 0 / 19 | 20 / 0 / 20 |
| two_feature, weaker (40% flips) | 1 / 0 / 2 | 4 / 0 / 3 | 13 / 0 / 13 | 14 / 0 / 14 |
| two_feature, shift + gradient boosting | 6 / 0 / 6 | 12 / 0 / 12 | 20 / 2 / 20 | 20 / 1 / 20 |
| young_low_income, shift + gradient boosting † | 1 / 0 / 1 | 6 / 0 / 5 | 14 / 0 / 13 | 18 / 0 / 18 |

## False alarms (no hidden group)

Runs (of 20) in which any group was confirmed, as **tree / k-means / both**; `unavail` counts runs where the check refused to run. The false discovery rate was set to 5%.

| Scenario | n=1000 | n=2000 | n=5000 | n=10000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| null, logistic | 0 / 1 / 1 | 0 / 1 / 1 | 0 / 1 / 1 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| null, gradient boosting | 0 / 1 / 1 | 4 / 3 / 2 | 2 / 1 / 3 | 0 / 0 / 0 |
| null, over-confident (T=1.5) | 0 / 2 / 1 | 0 / 2 / 0 | 0 / 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 / 0 |

Pooled false-alarm rate of the combined method on available null runs: 10/240 = 4.2% (95% Wilson interval 2.3% to 7.5%).

## Cost

Mean seconds per detection (combined method, evaluation set size n): n=1000: 0.08s, n=2000: 0.10s, n=5000: 0.14s, n=10000: 0.21s.
